text_block_list.text:
Magnificent skill. To bend such a flimsy 
crane arm to your will.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please don't be so modest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You displayed overwhelming 'power' in the 
way of the crane game—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then as someone strong, you ought to take 
pride in that.
